      "value": "<h1 id=\"fuzzy-control-strategy-for-regenerative-braking\">Fuzzy Control Strategy for Regenerative Braking</h1>\n<p>This module implements a comprehensive fuzzy control strategy for managing regenerative braking force distribution in electric vehicles with in-wheel motors. The system optimizes the ratio of motor braking force to total front-axle braking force while considering driving speed, braking intensity, and various vehicle parameters.</p>\n<h2 id=\"overview\">Overview</h2>\n<p>The fuzzy control system consists of five main components:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>FuzzyRegenerativeBrakingController</strong>: Implements the core fuzzy logic control algorithm</li>\n<li><strong>RegenerativeBrakingTorqueModel</strong>: Calculates optimal torque distribution and manages motor constraints</li>\n<li><strong>FuzzyControlIntegration</strong>: Integrates the fuzzy controller with the torque model and provides a unified interface</li>\n<li><strong>HydraulicElectromagneticRegenerativeDamper</strong>: Implements hydraulic electromagnetic shock absorbers for energy harvesting</li>\n<li><strong>HydraulicDamperIntegration</strong>: Combines regenerative braking and damping systems for comprehensive energy management</li>\n</ol>\n<h2 id=\"key-features\">Key Features</h2>\n<h3 id=\"fuzzy-logic-control\">Fuzzy Logic Control</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Input Variables</strong>: Driving speed, braking intensity, battery SOC, motor temperature</li>\n<li><strong>Output Variables</strong>: Regenerative braking ratio, motor torque</li>\n<li><strong>Membership Functions</strong>: Trapezoidal functions for smooth transitions</li>\n<li><strong>Rule Base</strong>: 17 fuzzy rules covering various driving scenarios</li>\n<li><strong>Defuzzification</strong>: Centroid method for crisp output values</li>\n</ul>\n<h3 id=\"hydraulic-electromagnetic-regenerative-dampers\">Hydraulic Electromagnetic Regenerative Dampers</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Energy Harvesting</strong>: Converts suspension movement into electrical energy</li>\n<li><strong>Electromagnetic Induction</strong>: Uses Faraday's law for power generation</li>\n<li><strong>Hydraulic Damping</strong>: Provides vehicle stability and comfort</li>\n<li><strong>Adaptive Control</strong>: Adjusts to road conditions and vehicle state</li>\n<li><strong>Thermal Management</strong>: Prevents overheating with intelligent derating</li>\n</ul>\n<h3 id=\"torque-model\">Torque Model</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Multi-Motor Support</strong>: Handles 2-motor (front) or 4-motor (all-wheel) configurations</li>\n<li><strong>Dynamic Constraints</strong>: Real-time motor temperature and power limitations</li>\n<li><strong>Vehicle Stability</strong>: Stability-optimized distribution for cornering scenarios</li>\n<li><strong>Safety Limits</strong>: Comprehensive safety constraints and thermal protection</li>\n</ul>\n<h3 id=\"integration-system\">Integration System</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Real-Time Control</strong>: Processes control cycles with input validation and safety monitoring</li>\n<li><strong>Environmental Adaptation</strong>: Adjusts for road surface conditions and weather</li>\n<li><strong>Performance Monitoring</strong>: Tracks efficiency metrics and system health</li>\n<li><strong>Failsafe Operation</strong>: Automatic fallback to mechanical braking in fault conditions</li>\n</ul>\n<h2 id=\"usage\">Usage</h2>\n<h3 id=\"basic-usage\">Basic Usage</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { \n  createFuzzyControlSystem, \n  defaultVehicleParameters, \n  createTestInputs \n} from './modules/fuzzyControl';\n\n// Create the control system\nconst controlSystem = createFuzzyControlSystem(defaultVehicleParameters);\n\n// Create test inputs\nconst inputs = createTestInputs({\n  vehicleSpeed: 80,        // km/h\n  brakePedalPosition: 0.5, // 50% braking\n  batterySOC: 0.6         // 60% charge\n});\n\n// Process control cycle\nconst outputs = controlSystem.processControlCycle(inputs);\n\nconsole.log('Motor Torques:', outputs.motorTorques);\nconsole.log('Regenerated Power:', outputs.regeneratedPower, 'W');\nconsole.log('Energy Recovery Efficiency:', outputs.energyRecoveryEfficiency);\n</code></pre>\n<h3 id=\"advanced-configuration\">Advanced Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { \n  FuzzyControlIntegration,\n  VehicleParameters,\n  SafetyLimits \n} from './modules/fuzzyControl';\n\n// Custom vehicle parameters\nconst vehicleParams: VehicleParameters = {\n  mass: 2200,                    // kg - heavier vehicle\n  frontAxleWeightRatio: 0.55,    // 55% front weight distribution\n  wheelRadius: 0.4,              // m - larger wheels\n  motorCount: 4,                 // all-wheel drive\n  maxMotorTorque: 500,           // Nm - higher performance motors\n  motorEfficiency: 0.94,         // 94% efficiency\n  transmissionRatio: 1.0         // direct drive\n};\n\n// Custom safety limits\nconst safetyLimits: SafetyLimits = {\n  maxRegenerativeBrakingRatio: 0.75,  // More conservative\n  maxMotorTorque: 500,\n  maxMotorTemperature: 140,           // Lower thermal limit\n  maxBatteryChargeCurrent: 300,\n  minMechanicalBrakingRatio: 0.25     // Higher mechanical backup\n};\n\n// Create system with custom parameters\nconst controlSystem = new FuzzyControlIntegration(vehicleParams, safetyLimits);\n</code></pre>\n<h2 id=\"system-architecture\">System Architecture</h2>\n<h3 id=\"input-processing\">Input FuzzyControlIntegration;\n  private piezoHarvester: PiezoelectricHarvesterController;\n  \n  constructor() {\n    this.fuzzyControl = new FuzzyControlIntegration(vehicleParams);\n braking\n    const brakingEnergy = this.fuzzyControl.processControlCycle(vehicleData.systemInputs);\n    \n    // Process piezoelectric harvesting from road vibrations\n    const vibrationData =    environmentalConditions: vehicleData.environmentalConditions\n    });\n    \n    // Combine energy sources\n    return this.combineEnergySources(brakingEnergy, piezoEnergy);\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3 id=\"real-time-monitoring\">Real-time Monitoring</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Real-time performance monitoring\nclass PiezoHarvesterMonitor {\n  private This module provides analytical, numerical, and experimental methodologies to enhance the efficiency and reliability of piezoelectric energy harvesting systems.</p>\n<h2 id=\"overview\">🎯 Overview</h2>\n<p>This system implements advanced piezoelectric energy harvesting capabilities that integrate seamlessly with existing regenerative braking systems. It provides:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Analytical Modeling</strong>: Comprehensive mathematical models for piezoelectric energy conversion</li>\n<li><strong>Numerical Optimization</strong>: Advanced algorithms for system optimization (Genetic Algorithm, Particle Swarm, Simulated Annealing)</li>\n<li><strong>Multi-Source Harvesting</strong>: Energy collection from road vibrations, suspension movement, and tire deformation</li>\n<li><strong>Performance Optimization</strong>: Real-time efficiency and reliability enhancement</li>\n<li><strong>Experimental Validation</strong>: Model control systems and energy management</li>\n</ol>\n<h3 id=\"key-features\">Key Features</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Material Database</strong>: Comprehensive database of piezoelectric materials (PZT-5H,
